about: Richard Warren Mithoff attended law school and graduated from The University of Texas School of Law in 1971. Richard Mithoff began practicing law in 1972.
Richard Mithoff is an attorney at Mithoff Law Firm, helping people with Personal Injury - General: Plaintiff issues. Mithoff Law Firm has an office in Houston, Texas, serving the local community.

Richard Mithoff was selected to Super Lawyers for 2003 - 2026. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.
